English Sentence: Byte : The encoded unit representing one alphanumeric character in a page of text. Each byte comprises eight binary digits with a value of '1' or '0' . A byte can therefore have 256 different combinations. The capacity of the primary storage of RAM of a computer is expressed in bytes (b). The multiples of a byte are kilobytes (Kb). Or 1.024 bytes: megabytes (Mb) or 1.024 Kb: gigabytes (Gb). or 1.024 Mb. The megabyte (Mb) is the most widespread unit for quantifying the capacity of a hard disk or primary storage unit of a microcomputer.
